props.title: Doors, dinner, the program, and after.
props.lede: Each part of the evening wants a different amount of music, and the program wants none.

rows.text: The duo, upright bass and guitar, plays the standards while guests find their names and their people. You can tell the music is live from across the venue, and it stays under the first hour of conversation.
The trio, with the drums played with brushes, plays at a level the whole table talks across. Changes Jazz Trio plays this size as a named group, with a modern edge on the songbook.
Silence, on cue. The band plays up to the moment and stops while your speaker is still steps from the microphone, and a walk-up for each award is planned on the run of show.

The quartet, the trio plus a horn or a singer out front, plays the swing and the soul end of the songbook for the hour the dance floor opens. When the night should run past that, the DJ or a covers band carries the after-party through the same sound system, on the same contract.

props.title: The corporate nights that book a jazz band.

rows.text: The duo plays the whole evening, for twenty at one table or eighty at ten, and the conversation is the event.
The trio plays through dinner, goes silent for the program, and comes back as the quartet after it. A gala is where the horn is worth having.
The trio plays drinks and dinner, then the quartet with a singer takes the first hour of the dance floor, or hands off to the DJ. In December the Christmas jazz trio plays the season’s songs.
The duo plays a lodge dinner, with the mountain going dark through the glass.

props.title: Asked about jazz bands for corporate events.

items.q: Which size of jazz band does a corporate event need?
items.a: A reception or a dinner for up to eighty wants the duo or the trio. A ballroom of two hundred wants the trio through dinner and the quartet, with a horn or a singer out front, once the program ends. Tell us the headcount, the venue and whether the evening has a dance floor, and we'll recommend the size. Signet Artists books jazz bands across Denver and the Colorado mountains.

At the doors and through dinner, about the level of the conversation, so a table talks across it without raising voices. For the program, silent. After it, the quartet plays like a dance band, up to what the venue allows.
Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through every break, so the evening never goes quiet by accident. An announcement microphone is ready from sound check.

items.q: What do you need from us to quote it?
items.a: The date, the venue, the headcount and a rough outline of the evening: doors, dinner, a program, a dance floor or not. From that we recommend a size and send one price with sound, setup and strike included, and the venue gets the footprint and power list to check.
